scenes.text: The seed-ship Amaranth had drifted empty for ninety years.
scenes.art_prompt: a long derelict seed-ship drifting in darkness, cold hull, distant stars, cinematic

scenes.text: When the salvage crew boarded, its lights came on to greet them.
scenes.art_prompt: corridor lights flickering to life inside an abandoned spacecraft, dust, eerie

scenes.text: Every corridor was lined with sealed growth pods. Every pod was full.
scenes.art_prompt: rows of glowing growth pods along a dark spacecraft corridor, faint shapes inside

scenes.text: The ship's log held one final instruction, written in the crew's own hand.
scenes.art_prompt: an old terminal glowing with a single line of text, deep space control room

scenes.text:
The Amaranth was never lost. It had finished growing its crew long ago.
It was waiting for a living navigator, because only a living mind can dream a route through the dark.
scenes.art_prompt: a lone navigator silhouette before a vast star map, faint and cold, deep space

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
scenes.art_prompt: a silent seed-ship against a vast nebula, stars, quiet and final
